messages:
PagerDuty Bot: P1 alert: sudden jump in 429s and client retries on /v1/chat.stream (region eu-central). Triggered at 2026-03-15T11:20:22Z.

Maya K: seeing it on the live heatmap. 429 rate ~4x baseline, p95 latency also creeping up. Can someone check whether this maps to particular API keys or tenants?

IncidentBot: correlated spike: tenants -> gamma-marketing, internal-partner; top api_key prefixes: sk_live_9f*. High concurrency patterns detected. No new prod deploys in last 20m.

Tom H: ok. I'll put a conservative concurrency cap on live keys with prefix sk_live_9f at 8 concurrent requests to stop head-of-line blocking. Applying now.

Chris R: also seeing lots of multi-part streaming sessions with 16k contexts. Those are expensive. We should enable streaming-truncate for sessions > 8k to cut token work.

Jae P: I'll flip streaming truncation to 8k for public proxy: `proxy-config set streaming_truncate_threshold=8192 --scope=prod --reason="live mitigation"`

Maya K: please do that and add a short banner for product teams. Also, can we temporarily disable the experimental reranker route? It's causing spikes in request fanout.

Tom H: disabling reranker route (feature-flag ff.rerank=false). That should reduce cross-service calls.

Watcher: automation note: concurrency cap applied; reranker disabled; streaming truncation enabled. Expect ~30% compute reduction for affected worker pool.

Chris R: I also submitted a quick k8s scale to add two more inference pods for text-gen pool, but keep HPA paused to avoid oscillation. Manual scale applied: replicas from 12 -> 14. Pods are starting but warm-up takes ~90s.

Maya K: good. Manual scale helps but we should be careful — more pods help throughput but increases cold-start KV cache misses. Keep caps in place.

Tom H: adding a token-bucket rate-limit at the edge for internal-partner to 100 rps with burst 200 for 10m. This should stop the sea of short retries.

Jae P: applied: `edgectl rate-limit add --key-prefix sk_live_9f --rps 100 --burst 200 --duration 10m --owner eng-oncall`

IncidentBot: note: clients are seeing increased 429 -> client retries. Recommend adding a temporary note on status page advising backoff behavior if outage persists.

Maya K: agree. Emma from Product is not on this thread; I'll ping #customer-commms after we have a stable baseline. For now, internal status draft: "Investigating elevated 429s caused by traffic surges. Temporary rate limits and feature toggles in effect."

Chris R: metrics check 4m after initial caps: 429 rate fell 42%, p95 latency improved 25%. However, there's still a persistent tail from gamma-marketing. The logs show long prompt lengths and many retries from SDK v3.1.

Tom H: can we selectively route gamma-marketing to the quantized model family (gq-small-q4) to reduce GPU pressure? Use model routing policy with fallback.

Jae P: routing change pushed: `routectl update --tenant gamma-marketing --primary gpt-medium --fallback gq-small-q4 --healthcheck 5s`

Maya K: also enable the circuit-breaker for the public proxy on path /v1/chat.stream so a single noisy key can't starve the queue. Set threshold to 60% error rate over 1m.

Tom H: circuit-breaker enabled: `proxyctl circuit add --path /v1/chat.stream --threshold 60 --interval 60s --action reject`

Watcher: circuit-breaker tripped for one key, traffic for that key diverted to 429s as configured. Overall system latency improved.

Chris R: preparing for oncall handoff in 10m. I'll keep ratecaps and rerank flag until traffic is stable for 30m. No full removals until we ramp.

Maya K: please also add a short-lived synthetic load test against the hot endpoints to validate mitigations; use small tokens and don't exceed edge caps.

Jae P: synthetic run scheduled. Results: simulated throughput within safe thresholds, no new 503s.

Tom H: product note: one affected partner uses streaming heavily for live transcripts. If we keep truncation on, their UX may degrade. Pinged partner success to prepare a message.

IncidentBot: On-call handover scheduled to Chris R in 8 minutes. No further P1 triggers will transfer handoff.

Chris R: taking the handoff. My checklist: keep caps, monitor per-tenant 429 ratio, watch for 503s, and validate model fallback health. I'll escalate to Infra if queue depth exceeds 80% for >5m.

Maya K: outstanding: create dashboard tile for 'active circuit-breakers and affected keys' (obs ticket obs-1427). Also, add a short note to the SDK docs recommending jittered backoff in v3.

Chris R: logged obs-1427 and devex-980 for SDK guidance.

Watcher: 20m snapshot: aggregate 429s down 63% from peak, p95 latency down 38%, no 503s observed. Edge limits reduced noisy key traffic by 72%.

Tom H: ramp plan for de-escalation: step1 keep current caps 30m, step2 increase concurrency for sk_live_9f -> 12 for 15m, step3 if stable, remove stream truncation and rerank flag, step4 remove caps gradually.

Maya K: agreed. I'll coordinate the customer comms after step2. Chris, watch the first ramp closely.

Chris R: update in 30m or earlier if regression. Closing active mitigation note in incident doc and attaching timeline.

PagerDuty Bot: handoff complete  Chris R is on-call for incident 2780011222.

Maya K: thanks all, great fast work. :raised_hands:

Chris R: 30m update: stable. Initiating ramp step2: concurrency to 12. Will pause before full removal for 45m.

Watcher: final snapshot at 2780011480: system stable, 429 ~baseline+6%, no 503s, follow-ups: obs-1427, devex-980, internal postmortem schedule.

Maya K: marking action items and will archive thread after postmortem is created.
